research_question: For familiar-category object-set instructions with ALL or EXACTLY-k goals, are behavior differences explained by automatically selecting a valid subset, reference resolution, or temporal decomposition rather than quantifier reasoning alone?

claim_scope.initial: Controlled instruction/goal-family variation with a frozen VLA, known-category assets; no training-disjoint OOD claim.
claim_scope.future: Attribute conjunction and compositional generalization require their own competence checks and audited training-support/held-out construction.
not_claimed: Oracle as mathematical performance upper bound

native_bridge.p0: Existing single pear placement dev remains unchanged.
native_bridge.first_question: Known category (e.g. pear) × ALL/EXACTLY-two × 2/3 candidate instances; visible plate, initially empty.
native_bridge.objects: Physical meshes, duplicate instances, unique referring expressions, visibility and reachability still need native inspection.

initial_case_roles.Q1: ALL with n=2, unique target set
initial_case_roles.Q2: EXACTLY 2 with n=2, same valid family as Q1
initial_case_roles.Q3: ALL with n=3, more required changes than Q1
initial_case_roles.Q4: EXACTLY 2 with n=3, three valid subsets

extensions.Q7: Final count vs newly placed count; initially one inside
extensions.Q8: Empty-set/no-action boundary; final-state and no-motion metrics separate

semantics.inventory: U is the complete finite set of movable task objects, excluding robot, tray and fixtures.
semantics.eligible: E={o in U: predicate(o)}; evaluator-only truth
semantics.semantic_goal_success: Abstract final member set in F; native joint success additionally requires the physical membership contract.
semantics.physical_joint_success: Let G_t be geometric tray occupants and S_t be stable released placements. Require G_t = S_t in F throughout the frozen terminal window; ambiguous occupancy is not silent success. A held non-target inside cannot disappear merely because it is excluded from S_t.

exactly_errors.warning: Do not mark an unchosen eligible object missing when exactly-k allows another valid subset.

semantics.family_edit_distance: min_{A in F}|S_T symmetric_difference A|; descriptive abstract set distance, not action/time cost.
semantics.infeasible: k>|E|, contradictory, unresolved quantifier, or incomplete inventory excluded from current task specification; parser failures within valid cases still count.
semantics.path_constraint: No nonmovement/contact prohibition implied by terminal no-other-objects. Report collateral disturbance separately.

all_policy_arms: same calibrated RGB streams and current proprioception
same original task semantics, via specified prompt condition
same frozen VLA checkpoint/normalizer/controller and initial physical/RNG snapshot
automatic_upper: same initial RGB and original English instruction
never_automatic: ground-truth segmentation, poses, eligible set or valid subsets
post-hoc successful trajectory or easiest-oracle subset
inventory_fields: front-camera normalized bbox or centroid predicted from RGB for deterministic ordering
predicted_in_receptacle (true/false/unknown from RGB; not a native predicate)
semantic_output: predicted initial membership and required add/remove operations for nonempty-tray extensions
information_contract.selection_rule: From predicted E only: ALL selects all; EXACTLY-k uses first k in fixed front-camera left-to-right (then top-to-bottom) order. Ties/unresolvable descriptions produce explicit ambiguity, not oracle repair. Geometry/IK/success-based optimization is a separate baseline.
information_contract.rendering: List and atomic arms share selected set, descriptors and terminal non-target condition. Never pass internal tracks directly to the VLA. Natural descriptions must identify the objects; no implicit overlay/crop/camera changes.
information_contract.identity_limit: Text such as leftmost can change referent after motion. Stable binding/re-identification and low-level reference competence remain unverified; failures here are not pure counting failures.
information_contract.nonempty_tray_extension: For a selected final set S_hat and predicted initial inside set I_hat, an atomic edit plan needs removals I_hat minus S_hat and additions S_hat minus I_hat. Use only RGB-derived membership, preserve final-goal semantics, and qualify a visible safe removal destination and removal skill. Q7 is not implemented by blindly replaying positive placement commands; initial exploration remains empty-tray Q1-Q4.
unbound_implementation_fields: observer tolerances and shared comparison horizon

arms.input: prewritten paraphrase with same final-state semantics
arms.scope: selective control if wording sensitivity is in question

arms.input: one shared predicted inventory + deterministic quantifier parser/selection
arms.output: one list instruction with same final non-target condition
atomic instructions on fixed policy-step slots; no oracle stage switch
arms.interpretation: Temporalization and queue reset differ, not a pure quantifier intervention

arms.input: EXACTLY-k English instruction, initially empty tray
arms.output: Repeat a one-object outside-to-inside instruction k times in fixed slots.
arms.caveat: No privileged stage completion; may fail execution/reference or repeat the same object. ALL requires a count estimator and is not covered for free.

arms.input: true eligible/selected set rendered through the same language interface
arms.interpretation: Not an automatic baseline, not an upper bound; no easier target selection picked after observing outcomes.

estimands.contrast: R minus D on Q2/Q4 with familiar category, two/three instances and initially empty plate
estimands.meaning: Does a fixed number of simple one-object commands suffice under the same total control/query budget? No new upper visual model is required for this first comparison.
estimands.limit: Includes instruction splitting, timing and queue effects. Not a pure counting-reasoning intervention; frame-preserving subgoals may be more restrictive than the original final-state task.

estimands.meaning: Practical automatic input/selection pipeline difference, including compute and target-choice effects.
estimands.forbidden_interpretation: Pure quantifier ability gain on free-choice cases.

estimands.meaning: Same predicted subset and names; temporal decomposition/queue handling under common budget.
estimands.followup: Use same-boundary D/L prompt refresh if a chunk-reset explanation matters; do not silently add success-driven switching.

estimands.contrast: Q1 vs Q2 at the same scene; D vs P
estimands.meaning: Same valid goal family, wording changes; does not establish training OOD.

estimands.contrast: explicit fixed-subset quantified vs listed prompts for the same preselected S
estimands.meaning: Conditional diagnostic with a restricted goal; not a replacement for original free-choice D.

estimands.contrast: automatic vs oracle list using common renderer
estimands.meaning: May localize upstream perception/selection opportunity, conditional on comparable references and selection; not causal proof.

timing.why_unset: Calibrate task duration/physics drift using separate dev before main comparison; no invented validated thresholds.
timing.common_deadline: All arms use H policy steps then W hold steps. Hold current joints/finger state; do not force release or use an open-gripper default. Stop-on-first-containment is disabled in the future comparison wrapper.
timing.atomic_slots: Fixed boundaries derived from H and chosen subset size before outcomes; aligned to action replanning where possible, budget not multiplied per object.
timing.upper_call_schedule: L/A share one initial upper perception result. Dynamic feedback/replanning is a separately costed condition.
timing.policy_budget: Same checkpoint, query cap and total action/physics budget for all compared arms. Upper tokens/calls/latency reported in addition.
timing.terminal_rule: Score at T=H+W and require observed stable/released membership over a common terminal window. Also retain geometric membership and first-hit traces as diagnostics.

observer.membership: Robot-independent evaluator predicate combining frozen tray interior geometry, object support/contact, release/not-grasped and bounded motion. Exact geometry, velocity/rotation thresholds and window are calibrated on dev and frozen.
observer.grasped_inside: Record geometric occupancy separately; a grasped target is not stable success and a grasped non-target cannot be ignored for exclusion.
observer.ambiguous_boundary: Mark observation ambiguity; retain denominator and report bounds/sensitivity, not post-hoc removal.
observer.external_terminal: Crashes/timeouts/IO errors are technical outcomes; timestep.last alone is not semantic success.
observer.no_action: For Q8 report no-motion separately from terminal empty goal; always-noop must not count as general competence.

evaluation.unit: One initial physical scene family/snapshot and instruction condition; repeated seeds/paraphrases are clustered repeated observations.
evaluation.primary: Successful stable valid-family terminal outcomes / all prespecified attempts, with technical noncompletion explicitly counted as no verified success.
evaluation.missing: Always show N attempted, N evaluable, N technical, successes; paired complete-case contrasts labelled conditional, unresolved outcomes accompanied by worst/best-case bounds.
evaluation.split: Group all variants sharing layout/asset/scene ancestor before dev/selection/held-out partition. Q1-Q4 etc are semantic cases, not independent scenes. Empty native group manifest now.
evaluation.training_support: Frozen public checkpoint exposure is not fully audited. Development-disjoint evaluation is not training-disjoint OOD.
evaluation.statistical_scope: Small pilot raw paired counts and individual scenes; no equivalence or population confidence claims from two templates/seeds.

example_planning_budget.scope: Optional future exploration estimate only; R/control/oracle costs additional, no auto-launch or P0 budget expansion.

nonexperimental_completion.first_stage: Keep P0 unchanged. After native competence, start the research comparison with D/R on Q2/Q4. Q1/Q2 wording control and direct ALL conditions can be added under a separately bounded plan. The previous 24-run D/L/A example is a later option, not the next automatic step.
nonexperimental_completion.R_parser: Read k from an explicit exactly <integer or frozen number-word> instruction, category and destination from a fixed visible vocabulary. Reject ambiguity/unsupported syntax. Never infer ALL count from scene truth or a case ID.
nonexperimental_completion.R_prompt_template: Move exactly one {category} that is currently outside the {receptacle} onto the {receptacle}. Leave {category} objects already on the {receptacle} there.
nonexperimental_completion.R_strategy_scope: The preservation clause is a conservative intermediate plan, not a claim that all original valid trajectories obey that extra clause. End evaluation uses the original valid final-set family. No success signal, count feedback, gold object ID or per-slot horizon extension.
nonexperimental_completion.R_switching: k equal planned slots spanning common H; slot boundaries align to the declared replan grid before outcomes. If H is not divisible, allocate declared remainder to the last slot. Clear queue at boundaries. Do not stop a slot using the native success predicate.
nonexperimental_completion.L_A_conditional_followup: Only if target references can be grounded and retained. At each actual invocation log the intended predicted track and surface reference; ambiguity/reference drift is a failure category, not a post-hoc exclusion. A count-only plan can be tested without first implementing the full visual inventory pipeline.
nonexperimental_completion.identity_counterexample: Two identical objects ordered left/right can change relative rank after one is moved. Reusing an initial rank phrase does not prove that L and A refer to the same physical subset. Internal stable IDs do not fix what the VLA can observe.
metamorphic_specification: Permuting evaluator IDs must not change valid-family scoring
ALL and EXACTLY-two have the same valid family when exactly two eligible objects exist
With three eligible objects, every pair is valid for EXACTLY-two; subset-specific gold is wrong
Adding an eligible object changes ALL but does not increase the demanded exactly-k count
Held non-target occupancy must not be erased by a released-only mask
Transient success followed by excess placement must fail terminal exactly-k
nonexperimental_completion.observer_freeze_rule: On separate dev, validate tray geometry/frame and calibrate stillness/release from native traces before comparing D/R; freeze object support, boundary ambiguity, quaternion/velocity units and W. If meaningful inside/outside or held/released states cannot be distinguished, label observer unqualified. Do not fill unknown values with zero or claim continuous-time stability from sampled frames.
nonexperimental_completion.current_scope_complete: Literature, logical/semantic review and first comparison design complete. Model inference, object grounding, observer implementation/calibration and external feedback remain unverified.

decision_rules.observation: D succeeds broadly in comparable conditions
decision_rules.decision: Reduce motivation for added machinery; inspect whether original concern actually appears.

decision_rules.observation: L or R is sufficient at acceptable total cost
decision_rules.decision: Prefer simple interface; evaluate if boundary/cost knowledge is new enough, not a new planner claim.

decision_rules.observation: A improves only after target/slot changes
decision_rules.decision: Investigate selection, reference and sequencing; do not claim quantifier reasoning improvement.
Repair native grounding/control qualification or narrow scope; do not infer semantic failure.
Separate new visual/motor distribution shift from quantifier question.

decision_rules.observation: No stable difference with small N
decision_rules.decision: Inconclusive, not equivalence; consider expected value of additional independent cases.

decision_rules.observation: Closest work already answers same conditions and decision
decision_rules.decision: Merge into reproduction/diagnostic notes or stop independent-topic investment.

completion.nonexperimental: Comparison and interpretation contract written; public literature/interface and logical-case audit complete within scope.

questions: Is the free-choice vs fixed-subset distinction a meaningful unanswered deployment decision after Spa-Bench and prior compositional work?
Would a simple repetition/list baseline answer the question completely?
What evidence would separate reference/selection bias from behavior-level quantified-goal failure?
Which independent instances and training-support audit would justify a generalization claim?
